main_text.l: Generosissimo & Excellentissimo DOMINO DOMINO GEORGIO FREDERICO, COMITI WALDECENSI, Pyrmontano & Culemburgensi FOEDERATÆ BELGICÆ EXERCITUUM DUCI.

OPtatissimæ pacis lux, cum non ira pridem post tantas tenebras & tam illætabilem noctem salutaris syderis instar nobis affulsit, exultantes gaudio pro coelesti hoc munere ter Optimo Deo laudes & grates egimus, & Tibi, Generosissime Comes, fausta quæque sumus precati, cujus virtuti & consilio præcipue debetur, quo

page.notes: The opening word is a large woodcut initial "O" joined to "Optatissimæ"; I have transcribed it as "Ptatissimæ" in the first line after the initial, with the initial letter shown as O. Several words in the body are uncertain due to print damage: "Ptatissimæ" may be "Optatissimæ" and "sumus" may be "summus"; the line "virtuti" has a superscript ti; "debetur" has a superscript r. Marginal mark at left edge is not printed text. Catchword "quo" printed at foot right.
